Questions

Frequently asked questions

What most people ask before getting started.

How much does a project cost?

It depends on the size. We send you a clear quote with no surprises, so you can decide at your own pace.

How long does it take?

A website can be ready in weeks; a custom app or program, in one to three months. We always give you a timeline upfront.

Do I need to know about technology?

No. We take care of everything: domain, design, deployment and maintenance. You just tell us your idea.

What happens after my website or app goes live?

It stays running and, if you want, we take care of it with maintenance: updates, fixes and improvements.

Can I hire only maintenance?

Yes. If you already have a site or program built by someone else, we review it, fix it and maintain it.
